My Projects

IN DEVELOPMENT 🛡️
GCP Security Patrol Dashboard
A live security patrol management dashboard built on Power BI, fed by Microsoft OfficeForms and a structured PatrolData model. Guards submit patrol reports via forms; the dashboard surfaces real-time flags by area, live area status (Action / Monitor / Clear), average patrol durations, and a full incident log — giving supervisors instant visibility across every floor.
Power BI OfficeForms Live Dashboard Incident Tracking Data Modelling

Live dashboard — real-time flags, patrol durations & area status across all floors

COMPLETED 🧾
Automated Receipt Tracker
A Google Apps Script solution that scans a labelled Gmail inbox, extracts receipt attachments, logs them into a structured Google Sheet with category, date, total, vendor, and receipt number — then links each entry back to the file stored in Google Drive. Uses MD5 file-hash fingerprinting to prevent duplicate entries, even across Gmail threading quirks.
